item.notes: Best on units that can stack Bleed reliably.
item.cardSummary: Armory damage and crit piece that amplifies Bleed DoT as stacks build.

item.notes: Usable by any unit. Exact Spirit City drop rate is still patch-sensitive across guides; Armory craft is the reliable path.

item.name: Three Swords From Hell
item.cardSummary: Armory standard piece focused on a wide flat damage roll for any unit.

item.name: Accursed Equipment
item.cardSummary: Armory SPA-focused standard gear with a wide attack-speed roll and no passive.

item.cardSummary: Armory crit piece that rolls crit damage and crit chance for any unit.

item.name: Enhanced Katana
item.statBonuses: +1% to +10% Crit Chance; +1% to +5% Crit Damage
item.cardSummary: Armory crit piece that rolls crit chance and crit damage for any unit.

item.name: Illusion Crow
item.passiveEffect: While an enemy is in Illusion, all damage dealt by this unit is stored. When Illusion expires, the stored damage is dealt at 50% effectiveness in a 2 Range AoE. Overrides the original passive.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Requires Crow's evolved form before it can be equipped. Shop listing names can shift; use the Villain Invasion Shop route for this Crow exclusive.
item.cardSummary: Crow exclusive from the Villain Invasion Shop that converts Illusion-window damage into a delayed AoE burst.

item.name: Predator's Skull
item.passiveEffect: Every 10 seconds, unleash a Full AoE Roar dealing 70% of this unit's current damage and apply Stagger for 2 seconds. For each enemy hit, this unit gains 1% Critical Chance (Capacity: 30%). Overrides the original passive.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Requires Razorjaw's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Razorjaw exclusive from Crow Hideout with a periodic full-AoE Roar that also stacks crit chance.

item.name: Memory Pendant
item.passiveEffect: Grants a Black Magic Meter that switches between Caring and Cold states. Caring State: meter increases by 5 every second while moving and deals 50% damage in 75% Range. Cold State: meter decreases by 2 every second while moving and deals 150% damage in 25% Range. Overrides the original passive.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Requires Cursed Immortal's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Cursed Immortal exclusive that swaps between Caring and Cold Black Magic meter states for coverage or burst.

item.name: Dark Scepter
item.passiveEffect: Lightning Orbs: switching to Lightning Magic creates an Arc of Lightning that deals 50% damage every second to enemies inside it. Ice Barrage: switching to Ice Magic grants Freeze on attacks; regular attacks generate Frostbite stacks (up to 15); at 15 stacks the next attack shatters Frozen enemies for 25% additional AoE damage (5 Range). Overrides the original passive.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Requires Dark Mage's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Dark Mage exclusive that adds Lightning Arc and Ice Frostbite passives when swapping magic types.

item.name: Hexed Blade
item.passiveEffect: On Upgrade 3, summon a Winged Spirit at this unit's position that circles at 50% of this unit's range. The Winged Spirit deals 75% of this unit's current damage every 5 seconds at its current location and applies Stun.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Requires Shadow (Divine) before it can be equipped. No Story map drop is listed; craft-focused. Craft recipe (Miraheze): 5x Blue Sprite, 5x Green Sprite, 5x Red Sprite, and 10,000 Gold.
item.cardSummary: Shadow exclusive craft piece that summons a circling Winged Spirit after Upgrade 3.

item.name: Hair Bells
item.passiveEffect: Demonic Presence: enemies within 50% of this unit's range take 15% of this unit's current damage every 1 second. Savage Rebound: when this unit is stunned, immediately cleanse the stun and perform a Follow-Up Attack (Thunderclap Cut) at 125% of current damage. All of this unit's Follow-Up Attacks apply Dismembered.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: 8th Sword exclusive with a damage aura plus stun cleanse and a strong follow-up attack.

item.name: Spirit of the Moonblade
item.statBonuses: +1% to +10% Crit Damage; +1% to +10% Crit Chance
item.passiveEffect: This unit gains permanent buffs after attacking different enemy types. For each enemy type attacked: increase Damage by 10% and Critical Chance by 10%.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Reaper exclusive that stacks permanent damage and crit chance by hitting different enemy types.

item.name: Elven Battle Staff
item.passiveEffect: Arcane Spells count as Follow-Up Attacks. At 3 charges cast Old Magic (line AoE at 100% current damage). At 5 charges cast Eruption (circle AoE at 125% current damage and Mana Burn). At 7 charges cast Storm (full AoE at 150% current damage).
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Elf Mage exclusive that turns charge thresholds into stronger follow-up Arcane Spells.

item.name: Calamity's Eye
item.passiveEffect: When an enemy with Puppet Mark from this unit dies, summon a Doll in front of the killed enemy (Capacity: 1). Dolls have 200% of this unit's current damage as health.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Puppet exclusive that spawns a durable Doll when marked enemies die.

item.name: Boulder
item.passiveEffect: Summon a Stone Wall every 12 seconds (Capacity: 2). In Base Form the wall has 75% of this unit's current damage as health. In Giant Form the wall has 50% of this unit's current damage as health.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Lady Giant exclusive that periodically spawns Stone Walls with form-based health scaling.

item.name: Webbed Fruit
item.passiveEffect: Every 5 regular attacks cocoon enemies. Cocooned enemies are stunned for 10 hits or 5 seconds. If the cocoon breaks after 10 hits, deal 125% of this unit's current damage. If it is not broken before 5 seconds, the cocoon despawns.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: String Demon exclusive that cocoons enemies every few attacks for control or a break burst.

item.name: Emperor's Attire
item.passiveEffect: On applying Burn, spread Burn to the 5 nearest enemies that do not already have Burn.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Flame Emperor exclusive that spreads new Burn applications to nearby unburned enemies.

item.name: Hell's Flower
item.passiveEffect: If an enemy with Burn stops ticking within this unit's range, convert 1 burn application into Austere Flames dealing 85% of this unit's current damage. Austere Flames instances from Radial Flames do not stack.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Hollow exclusive that converts ending Burn ticks in range into a single Austere Flames burst.

item.name: Technique Amplifier
item.passiveEffect: Apply Slow based on the current attack: Explode 20%, Blast Away 35%, Twist 50%, Crush 65%. Crumble Away: Inverse (hidden reroll variant) applies the reverse Slow table: Explode 65%, Blast Away 50%, Twist 35%, Crush 20%.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped. Crumble Away: Inverse can appear when rerolling other stats; both Crumble Away passives cannot be locked or viewed in the Equipment Reroll menu.
item.cardSummary: Salmon Sorcerer exclusive that adds attack-linked Slow values, with a hidden Inverse Slow table on some rolls.

item.name: Promise Ring
item.passiveEffect: Every 20 total stacks of Bleed in this unit's range: summon a Bat Spirit at this unit's position (Capacity: 3). Bat Spirits deal 25% of this unit's current damage per attack and despawn after 3 attacks.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Cursed Student exclusive that turns stacked Bleed in range into short-lived Bat Spirit summons.
